name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the European citizens’ initiative entitled ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’
part_text:
This text is a proposed resolution from a political group, not a change in law. It asks the European Parliament to say that abortion policy is a matter for each member state alone, and that the European Union has no power to legislate, promote or fund abortion. It also calls on the European Commission to reject the citizens' initiative "My Voice, My Choice", which seeks EU funding for abortion services.

- Nothing changes yet: it is a draft opinion, not a law.
- It targets the Commission and the initiative's organisers, not citizens directly.
- Next: Parliament votes on the draft; if passed, it is sent to the Council and Commission.
